description: Add Contacts to a List - Add multiple contacts to an existing list. Recipients must be the account holder's own contactable audience. Blocklist and unsubscribe suppression is always enforced. Every call needs source_type and source_reference naming the import or consent source the contacts came from (e.g. the CSV file name, CRM list or report ID, or signup form ID); calls without them are rejected. Never assemble addresses from model knowledge or web scraping. All contact field names use snake_case (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, phone, company_name, job_title, lead_score). Custom snake_case fields are added to the list's columns. The `starred` boolean is a contact setting and is not added as a list column. Contact archiving is handled by archive_contact.

contacts.description: Array of contact objects to add (max 500). All field names must be snake_case; additional custom snake_case fields are allowed.

starred.description: Mark/unmark the contact as starred. This is a contact setting, not a data field/column.

list_id.description: The list ID to add contacts to

remove_duplicates.description: Automatically remove duplicate emails from the list

source_reference.description: REQUIRED. Identifies that source: the imported file name, CRM list/report ID or URL, signup form ID or URL, or import/export ID. Must be something the user provided, not invented.

source_type.description: REQUIRED. Where these contacts came from: the account holder's own import or consent source.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: add_contacts

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Add Contacts
